cottage.name: Cottage
cottage.blurb: A small house with a hearth corner, a chest and a workbench.

smithy.name: Smithy
smithy.blurb: Stone workshop with a forge porch: anvil, grindstone, furnaces.

stable.name: Stable
stable.blurb: Three open stalls under one roof, with hay and a trough.

storehouse.name: Storehouse
storehouse.blurb: A tall barn with a cart door, a loft, barrels and chests.

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.blurb: A lookout over your land with a brazier on top.

market.name: Market Stall
market.blurb: A striped awning over a counter. Put one by your gate.

well.name: Well
well.blurb: A roofed well for the middle of the settlement.

library.name: Library
library.blurb: Two storeys of books, a reading table and eight Archive Shelves for the town's own lore.

garden.name: Kitchen Garden
garden.blurb: Fenced beds with a water channel, ready to plant.

house.name: House
house.blurb: One storey and a tall attic under a steep gable, with a chimney. About four beds.

townhouse.name: Townhouse
townhouse.blurb: A taller house: stone below, a jettied floor over the road, a high attic. About six beds.

farmhouse.name: Farmhouse
farmhouse.blurb: A long low farmhouse with an open lean-to behind for hay and the woodpile.

inn.name: Inn
inn.blurb: A tap room with the bar, tables and a hearth, and bedrooms above for travellers.

mint.name: Mint
mint.blurb: A strong stone house with barred windows, where the town strikes its Regals.

mason_yard.name: Mason's Yard
mason_yard.blurb: The mason's workshop, with a yard in front where he cuts and sells blocks.

ironworks.name: Ironworks
ironworks.blurb: An Ore Pit to start with: about 16 raw iron a day into its storeroom. It grows into a Bloomery and a Trip-Hammer Forge on this same plot.

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.blurb: The guardhouse a Barracks block raises: Men-at-Arms wait in it and come out to fight.
